Locks in long-duration offtake, reducing volume risk and supporting financing/returns.
Adds contracted volume; helps underpin Port Arthur Phase 2 utilization.
Ties demand to a specific project timeline and execution risk.
Revenue start is long-dated; near-term impact limited until operations begin.
Signals scale; capacity growth can lift long-term cash flows if contracted.

This extends Sempra Infrastructure’s trend of contracting LNG volumes tied to Port Arthur’s expansion. A larger catalyst would be additional SPAs that substantially cover Phase 2 capacity or earlier-than-expected project milestones.
